blocks.headline: Source by Category
blocks.description: 40+ certified organic SKUs across 6 product families. All available with full documentation.
blocks.subDescription: Each category independently certified — full CoA and traceability documentation available on request.

categories.title: Herbs (Whole & Rubbed)
categories.description: Premium oregano, laurel leaves, and sage sourced directly from our network of organic farms.

categories.title: Essential Oils (Steam Distilled)
categories.description: Pure steam-distilled oils from oregano, laurel, and sage for pharmaceutical and food applications.

categories.title: Spices (Seeds & Powders)
categories.description: High-purity cumin, anise, and fennel seeds processed to maintain volatile oil content.

categories.title: Botanicals (Flowers & Roots)
categories.description: Dried flowers and roots including chamomile and licorice, harvested at peak potency.

categories.title: Blends (Custom Formulations)
categories.description: Proprietary spice mixes and custom seasoning profiles developed for industrial food processors.

customProcessing.title: Custom Processing (Cleaning & Milling)
customProcessing.description: Advanced cleaning, sorting, and milling services tailored to specific particle size requirements.

blocks.headline: Built for Buyers Who Cannot Afford Mistakes.
blocks.description: Every system at Spicevo is designed around one principle: your import process should be the least stressful part of your business.

features.label: RELIABILITY
features.title: Shipments That Depart on Schedule
features.description: Container bookings confirmed at order placement. You receive the Bill of Lading draft before cargo loading.

features.label: COMPLIANCE
features.title: Every Certificate, Ready Before You Ask
features.description: EU Organic, USDA NOP, ISO 22000, HACCP, and Halal certificates available as originals or notarized copies.

features.label: COMMUNICATION
features.title: One Contact. Full Accountability.
features.description: Dedicated export coordinator assigned to your account. 48-hour maximum response on all technical and commercial queries.

traceability.label: TRACEABILITY
traceability.title: Farm-to-Container Traceability
traceability.description: Every batch is traceable to its origin cooperative. Lot numbers, harvest dates, and third-party lab results are available before you issue a purchase order.

blocks.headline:
ISO-Certified Processing.
Audited Annually.
blocks.description: Our 4,200 m² processing facility operates under continuous third-party audit. Every production line is dedicated by product family to prevent cross-contamination.
blocks.footnote: All certificates available as original documents or notarized copies upon request.

testimonials.quote: We have sourced certified oregano and laurel from Spicevo for four consecutive seasons. Documentation arrives before the vessel departs. That reliability is non-negotiable at our scale.
testimonials.author: Marcus Bauer

testimonials.quote: Spicevo resolved a consistent quality variance issue we had with our previous supplier within the first shipment. Their pre-shipment lab reports gave our QC team full confidence.
testimonials.author: Fatima Al Rashidi

testimonials.quote: The pharmaceutical-grade steam distillation process meets our strict Japanese import specifications. Certificates of Analysis are consistently above the minimum essential oil content threshold.
testimonials.author: Kenji Yamamoto
